author: Nemesis
what_it_is: Solo missions fully completed in Agent Mode, along with some cool cheats like Rocket Launchers unlocked.
format: DexDrive .n64: "123-456-STD" and a 0x1040-byte header (DexPlorer comments), then a 32 KiB Controller Pak: note NPDE/4Y "PERFECT DARK", 28 pages

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/n64-dexdrive.py convert perfect-dark-2000.34.n64 OUT: dexdrive: pak = the 32768 bytes after the 0x1040-byte header

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

verified.baseline: with no save: Choose Your Reality lists only New Agent...

mupen64plus-next.detail: Choose Your Reality lists only New Agent...: the game reads the pak (no damage message) but finds no agent file in the PERFECT DARK note; the same in all three cores

parallel-n64.detail: Choose Your Reality lists only New Agent...: the game reads the pak (no damage message) but finds no agent file in the PERFECT DARK note; the same in all three cores

mupen64plus.detail: Choose Your Reality lists only New Agent...: the game reads the pak (no damage message) but finds no agent file in the PERFECT DARK note; the same in all three cores

note: The PERFECT DARK note is intact as far as the pak's file system goes (28 pages, index table valid), but no core lists an agent from it. Posted 11 days after the game's US release, so it may come from the first revision; the library has only Rev 1 to test with.
